# Quality Standards — Yokai Tennis
<!-- Auto-generated by /ss:init on 2026-07-07. Quality level: Standard. -->

## Gates

- Minimum quality score: **80/100**
- Minimum test coverage: **80%**
- Gates enforced: true (checked by `/ss:ship` before merge)

## Performance budgets

- Bundle/APK size budget: not yet defined — revisit once LibGDX assets are added (sprite
  sheets and audio can dominate APK size quickly on a mobile game).
- Frame budget: target 60fps in-match on min-SDK-21-class devices. No profiling harness yet.

## Code quality

- Cyclomatic complexity threshold: 10
- Max file lines: 300
- Max function lines: 50
- Max function parameters: 5

## Testing

- Tests required for new logic (JUnit Jupiter).
- No Android instrumentation/e2e framework configured yet — flag before shipping any
  Activity/Fragment-level UI code untested.

## Code review

- Code review required: true
- Minimum reviewers: 1

## CI/CD

- Block merge on failure: true (no CI pipeline wired up yet — this is aspirational until one exists)

## Domain-specific checks

- Serve/shot mechanic tuning (apex-detection gesture logic) is flagged in SPEC.md as needing
  tuning to avoid false positives — treat as an area warranting extra test coverage once
  implemented.
- Patreon/IAP unlock flows touch monetization — no partial/silent-failure states; a failed
  verification must show an explicit message (see SPEC.md Flow 2 step 5b).

## Exemptions

*No exemptions currently granted.*
